description: Multi-Layer 3D Donut & Pie Chart combines four chart layouts — Donut 2D, Donut 3D, Pie 2D and Pie 3D — into one polished Power BI custom visual, with full multi-ring (concentric) rendering, KPI gauge mode and a richly organized formatting pane. Drop in your Legend field and one or more Values measures and the visual takes over: each Legend value becomes a slice, each measure becomes a ring, and the entire layout auto-fits the available space with proper 2D/3D rendering, smooth hover micro-interactions and an animated reveal on data change. KEY CAPABILITIES • Four layouts in one — toggle between Donut/Pie shapes and 2D/3D dimensions from the Chart Type card. Adjustable hole size, ring spacing, slice padding, corner radius, start angle, 3D depth and 3D tilt. • Multi-ring rendering — when Multiple Rings is on (default), each measure in your Values bucket becomes its own concentric ring; or use the optional Details field for series-driven ring splits. • Gauge / KPI mode — mark category names as "background" so they render but stay out of the legend and data labels (perfect for the "Remaining %" wedge in a progress dial). Optional curved per-ring labels show the measure name and filled %. • Per-slice color picker — Data Colors exposes one direct color picker per (ring × category) slice. No conditional formatting prompts, no fx button — just plain swatches. Defaults match across…
